info.description: Open-weight Muse Spark model with 816B total parameters and 42B active, released under the Muse Model License. The model card states a 1M-token context at inference; Meta publishes exact token counts per model and this page does not, so the context limit is unset. Input is text, image, video, and audio, and output is text. reasoning_effort accepts low, medium, high, or xhigh, and the default is xhigh. Meta does not publish a first-party API or a standard API price; weights are on Hugging Face and inference is hosted by third parties.

zh.description: 开放权重的 Muse Spark 模型，总参数 816B、激活 42B，许可证为 Muse Model License。模型卡写推理时上下文为 1M tokens；Meta 按模型给出精确 token 数，该页没有精确数字，因此上下文上限留空。输入为文本、图像、视频和音频，输出为文本。reasoning_effort 可取 low、medium、high 或 xhigh，默认 xhigh。Meta 未公布第一方 API，也没有 API 标准价；权重在 Hugging Face，推理由第三方托管。
